method: Live @oai/sky with one physical input and refreshed screenshot per action; 40 significant native checkpoints independently transcribed. Pinned full-manual statistics/data/capacity/error sections read from local OCR. Native runtime and extractor subsequently closed.

manualPolicy.entry: SD x DATA or x comma frequency DATA; paired x comma y DATA or x comma y comma frequency DATA. DATA is K29; comma is K03,K28.
manualPolicy.capacity: 100 storage slots: SD costs 1 or 2 with explicit frequency; paired costs 2 or 3 with explicit frequency. Error 3 on exceeding capacity.
manualPolicy.correction: Browse with DOWN oldest-first or UP newest-first; change current field then DATA. Comma-separated input replaces the entire selected record. Shifted CD deletes the current record. ON/C leaves browsing and starts fresh input.
manualPolicy.range: Existing pinned full-manual numeric range and error policy; signed/fractional weights observed natively; zero omits/deletes a record.

observations: STAT submenu pages show SD LINE QUAD, EXP LOG PWR, and INV; no three-variable STAT.
SD observation 1 stored as DATA SET= 1.; DOWN shows X1= 1. then N1= 1.
Editing N1 to 2 then ENT shows 2= 2.; DATA commits N1= 2.
SD observation 3 with frequency 0 leaves the existing DATA SET= 1. unchanged.
UP enters newest N field; shifted CD removes the record and shows DATA SET= 0.
LINE pair (2,4) stores one record; browsing shows X1= 2. and Y1= 4.
Whole-record correction 0,5 entered while browsing Y1 replaces X and Y; browsing X1 afterward shows 0.
Setting paired N1 to -2 commits -2.; setting it to 0 removes the whole record.
Paired DATA without a Y value shows Error 1, lower blank; ON/C recovers to Stat 1, 0.
Pair (1,2) with frequency 0.5 stores N1= 0.5; power off/on preserves it.
CA clears paired data; UP afterward remains Stat 1, 0.

limitations: The 100-slot stress cases and Error 3 use the primary full manual and implementation tests; the native simulator was not filled with 101 live records.

Native hidden precision at extreme input/frequency boundaries, cross-mode function/buffer restrictions and all private rounding remain the later Phase 17 audit. This phase does not establish full parity.
Golden raw-state numeric strings and entry/menu labels differ from native LCD strings; those differences are explicitly listed. Rendered significant field labels and values follow the observed LCD.
Physical means, deviations, regressions, estimates and normal probabilities remain Phase 12. No three-variable STAT is added.
